notes.title: Windows 10 and Game Guard Update
notes.notes:
Good day Khanatics,

Today, we have updated the client to include a Game Guard which auto bans anyone who uses cheats, this includes speed hack and cut. All auto bans have a length of 1 day for the 1st and 2nd offense. On the 3rd offense the cheater will be banned permanently.

Windows 8 and 10 will also get an update today with a temporary solution. Just choose the Play windows 8 or 10 option when pressing the Play button on the steam client. Just follow the instructions given.

Bakbakhan na ulit!
Blaze GM Team

NPC teleport required level mismatch

Make party quest reward dialog mistake

Thank you for all the reports and helping us in improving the game.

notes.title: Release Information
notes.notes:
Good day Khanatics,

Khan: Absolute Power is scheduled for release on Mar 18, 2016 at 7:00pm PDT or Mar 19, 2016 at 10:00am GMT+8. At this you will be able to download the game from the steam store. But the servers won't be up yet. 

Game servers will be up by Mar 18, 2016 at 11:00pm PDT or Mar 19, 2016 at 2:00pm GMT+8. 

Thank you for your patience Khanatics,
#Bakbakhan2016
